Affine independent check errors: 2.37 m, 11.40 m. Does not meet the 5 m registration gate; conservative source-constrained estimates only. First attempt matched the top-left roof to the northeastern row, creating a reflected fit. Corrected to the northwestern mapped roof 780476062; east-side Educare roof is an independent check. Imagery-to-OSM disagreements are clipped to complete mapped obstacles; no surveyed boundary, species, court markings, construction date or exact inventory inferred. No bitmap ships. Only supported interior links are authored; a complete source-clear frontage-to-building/pitch link could not be established from this reference. The approach gate remains unmet.
